policy: Closed enum. Codes are never reused or repurposed. Additions are additive within a major version. Format NP-<PLANE>-<NNN>.

TF-EVT-001.name: SCHEMA_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED
TF-EVT-001.message: Envelope schema_version is not supported by this server.

TF-EVT-003.name: MALFORMED_FIELD
TF-EVT-003.message: A field failed validation. See field_path, expected, received.

TF-EVT-004.name: UNKNOWN_ID_NAMESPACE
TF-EVT-004.message: user_ref or work_item_id namespace is not registered for this deployment.

TF-EVT-005.name: DUPLICATE_EVENT
TF-EVT-005.message: Idempotent no-op: an event with this natural key already exists. Not a failure.

TF-EVT-006.name: CONTENT_FIELD_REJECTED
TF-EVT-006.message: Payload contains a field that could carry prompt/response content. Structurally forbidden (BR-001).

TF-EVT-007.name: BATCH_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
TF-EVT-007.message: Batch exceeds max_batch_size. Split and resend; idempotency makes resends safe.

TF-EVT-008.name: VALUE_ASSERTION_REJECTED
TF-EVT-008.message: Payload contains a value/savings/ROI assertion field. The SDK witnesses facts; it never accepts valuations.

TF-EVT-009.name: TIMESTAMP_OUT_OF_RANGE
TF-EVT-009.message: Event timestamp is in the future or beyond the accepted backfill horizon.

TF-CFG-001.name: PARAMETER_OVERLAP
TF-CFG-001.message: Effective-date range overlaps an existing parameter version (BR: overlap-free windows).

TF-CFG-002.name: ROLE_DENIED
TF-CFG-002.message: Caller lacks the required role (e.g., FINANCE_PARAMS for parameter writes).

TF-CFG-003.name: DEPLOYMENT_EXISTS
TF-CFG-003.message: Deployment with this external reference already registered.

TF-CFG-004.name: NAMESPACE_CONFLICT
TF-CFG-004.message: Id-namespace mapping conflicts with an existing mapping.

TF-READ-001.name: FIGURE_NOT_FOUND
TF-READ-001.message: No figure with this id/period for the deployment.

TF-READ-002.name: PERIOD_NOT_COMPUTED
TF-READ-002.message: Requested period has no finalized computation yet. Response includes next_compute_at. Not a failure.

TF-READ-003.name: COHORT_NOT_DISCLOSABLE
TF-READ-003.message: Benchmark cohort below k_disclose. Response states threshold status (BR-014). Not a failure.

TF-AUTH-001.name: INVALID_API_KEY
TF-AUTH-001.message: API key missing, malformed, or revoked.

TF-AUTH-002.name: KEY_SCOPE_EXCEEDED
TF-AUTH-002.message: Key is not scoped to this deployment or plane.

TF-AUTH-003.name: TEST_KEY_IN_PRODUCTION
TF-AUTH-003.message: Test-scoped key used against production mode.

TF-RATE-001.name: RATE_LIMITED
TF-RATE-001.message: Per-tenant rate limit exceeded. Honor retry_after; client buffering + idempotent replay is the designed behavior.

TF-RATE-002.name: QUOTA_EXCEEDED
TF-RATE-002.message: Plan-level event quota exhausted for the period.

TF-SRV-001.name: INTERNAL
TF-SRV-001.message: Platform-side failure. Retry with backoff; report request_id if persistent.

TF-SRV-002.name: INGESTION_PAUSED
TF-SRV-002.message: Ingestion temporarily paused (correctness over liveness, e.g., checkpoint store unavailable). Buffer and replay.

TF-CFG-006.name: IMMUTABLE_FIELD
TF-CFG-006.message: Field cannot change after events exist for the deployment (e.g., type). Register a new deployment instead.

TF-CFG-007.name: MALFORMED_FIELD
TF-CFG-007.message: Config-plane body field failed validation. See field_path, expected, received.
